Name: NIGHT_BOSS_MENU_PARAM_ST
Description: The Nightlords in the Expedition menu (names, icons, unlock and defeat flags, sort order) and the weights used to pick the target boss at each Deep of Night depth.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 1 row.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: Expedition name text shown for this Nightlord in the Expedition menu.

Fields.Name: Boss Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown for this Nightlord in the Expedition menu and the other boss lists.

Fields.Name: Unlock Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that unlocks this Nightlord as an expedition. 0: unlocked from the start.

Fields.Name: Defeat Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that marks this Nightlord as defeated in the menus.

Fields.Name: Unknown ID
Fields.Description: Its use is not established. Retail 100100, 100200 ... 100800 on the eight base Nightlords (by boss), -1 on the others.

Fields.Name: Boss Name ID
Fields.Description: Boss name text for this Nightlord.

Fields.Name: Defeated Boss Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown for this Nightlord in the Expedition menu once defeated. Retail: 40471–40479 and 41900–41908. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Order of this Nightlord in the Expedition menu (lower first).

Fields.Name: Boss Description ID
Fields.Description: Boss description text for this Nightlord. Retail: 131070–131151. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Background ID
Fields.Description: Background image shown for this Nightlord in the Expedition menu. Retail: 40427–40469. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Effective Affinity 1
Fields.Description: Affinity shown as effective against this Nightlord (EFFECTIVE_AFFINITY). 0: none. Retail: one per boss (Fire, Magic, Lightning, Holy…). No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Effective Affinity 2
Fields.Description: Second affinity shown as effective against this Nightlord. 0: none. Retail: 0 on every row. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Deep of Night Weight: Depth 1
Fields.Description: Weight of this Nightlord in the Deep of Night target roll at depth 1. 0: not rolled at this depth. Retail: 1000 on six base Nightlords, 0 on the Everdark rows.

Fields.Name: Deep of Night Weight: Depth 2
Fields.Description: Weight of this Nightlord in the Deep of Night target roll at depth 2. 0: not rolled at this depth.

Fields.Name: Deep of Night Weight: Depth 3
Fields.Description: Weight of this Nightlord in the Deep of Night target roll at depth 3. 0: not rolled at this depth.

Fields.Name: Deep of Night Weight: Depth 4
Fields.Description: Weight of this Nightlord in the Deep of Night target roll at depth 4. 0: not rolled at this depth.

Fields.Name: Deep of Night Weight: Depth 5
Fields.Description: Weight of this Nightlord in the Deep of Night target roll at depth 5. 0: not rolled at this depth.

Fields.Name: Large Boss Icon ID
Fields.Description: Large icon shown for this Nightlord in the Expedition menu. Retail: 41820–41848. No reader was located.

Fields.Name: Force Target Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: When the target boss is picked for a Deep of Night depth: if this event flag is on and the boss's weight for that depth is at least 1, this boss is picked outright. 0 or -1: never. Retail 0.
